name: io.github.DanceNitra/inspeximus
description: Zero-dependency agent memory: recall, consolidation, and a first-class correction + erasure channel.

environmentVariables.name: INSPEXIMUS_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to the JSON memory file the server persists to (defaults to ./inspeximus_memory.json).

environmentVariables.name: INSPEXIMUS_ECHO_GUARD
environmentVariables.description: 1 (default) blocks a restated retired value from resurrecting a corrected fact; 0 = legacy keyed supersession.
